title: Sequential READ-loop — candidate for SQL query
description: PERFORM-UNTIL containing a READ is the classic COBOL "read each record" loop. When backed by a database, replace with a single SELECT and result-set iteration; when backed by a file, consider streaming with explicit termination handling.
suggestedReplacement:
EXEC SQL DECLARE CUR CURSOR FOR
    SELECT * FROM <table> WHERE ... END-EXEC.
EXEC SQL OPEN CUR END-EXEC.
PERFORM UNTIL SQLCODE = 100
    EXEC SQL FETCH CUR INTO :record END-EXEC
END-PERFORM.
